Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
Yop'
I heard you like nosferatus, so i made this deck with Patagia, flaps allowing limited flight.

" +1 stealth action.
Put this card on the acting Nosferatu. This vampire gets an optional maneuver each combat. Once each combat, this vampire may burn 1 blood to gain flight [FLIGHT] for the remainder of the round. A vampire may have only 1 Patagia card. "

As worded, the cards says "i can burn 1 blood anytime".

Q : I am bleeding my prey like a boss when suddenly a wild potence prince appears. Combat ensues. I manoeuver to long using my patagia. The opponent chooses Earthshock as his strike.
( text : " Strike: strength ranged damage. This strike cannot be dodged. Not usable against a minion with flight [FLIGHT]." )
Is it too late to gain flight at this point ? (I guess not)
Does it cancel opponent's strike ? (I'm not sure)

Imagination is our only weapon in the war against reality -Jules de Gaultier

Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body: It is too late to gain flight after the strike has been announced. Earth Shock cannot be announced as a strike against a minion with flight, it is irrelevant if the minion gains flight somewhere between announcement and resolution as the strike has already been played.

Messages.Author: Louhi
Messages.Body:
I wouldn't say it's too late to get flight (for example to be able to play Circle) but it won't affect the current strike resolution, the Earth Shock is already played.

Lidingö Scourge

Messages.Author: Wedge
Messages.Body: I am not sure. Is "usable" different than "playable"?

Messages.Author: Louhi
Messages.Body:
I don't think you're allowed to play a strike you're not allowed to use, e.g Taste of Death at close range. If the strike is rendered unusable after being played that's another story though. Compare immortal grapple 'Strikes that are not hand strikes may not be used this round (by either combatant)'. It seems like burning a blood for flight would make the Earth Shock fizzle (but not canceled).

I don't see any restrictions against burning a blood for flight at that point to answer question one.

Lidingö Scourge

Messages.Author: Malcolm Sprye
Messages.Body: That was my impression as well, Louhi. The immortal grapple example is excellent; you can't declare any invalid strikes after it's played, and any invalid strikes already played have no effect.

As the Earthshock (5 consons in a row...) card is played? Yes. Before declaring your strike? Definitely too late, as you are the acting vampire. Before strike resolution? No, there is time.

> Reyda wrote:
> Does it cancel opponent's strike ? (I'm not sure)
>
Yes. Well. The opponent's strike has no effect (even if Earthshock was targetting a retainer).
